organization.sub_sector: Enterprise revenue, billing, and data software

strategic_priorities.text: Expand gross margin by two points

organization.description: Large enterprise software company selling revenue, billing, and data products to businesses in the US, EU, and APAC. It buys external data from seven vendors costing $8B a year.

department_profiles.mission: Build and run the revenue-critical product systems.
Keep customer-facing platforms and billing operations running.
Own data pipelines, models, scores and analytics.
Own roadmap, releases and transformation projects.
Win and expand enterprise and mid-market revenue.
Protect retention, SLAs and customer health.
Own budget, cost targets, financial KPIs, vendor contracts and the close.
Own controls, auditability and regulatory posture.

pressures.name: Flux usage-based growth
pressures.description: Flux usage costs grow about 1.5% a month.

pressures.name: Vendor reconciliation failure
pressures.description: Reconciliation fails a few times a year; likelier if its inputs or owners weaken.

pressures.name: Billing reconciliation failure
pressures.description: Billing reconciliation fails about twice a year; likelier if its owners lose capacity.

pressures.name: Warehouse lineage holder leaves
pressures.description: Only one role knows the warehouse lineage; if it leaves, the financial close slips.

pressures.name: Contractor rate growth
pressures.description: Contractor rates rise about 1% a month.

evidence.snippet: Finance sets budget limits for Engineering and Marketing.
Exception path is undocumented; only the billing owners can resolve a failed run.
Billing reconciliation know-how is concentrated in two roles.
Invoicing runs after reconciliation completes.
A failed vendor reconciliation cost about $40M to correct.
A failed billing reconciliation cost about $60M in credits and rework.
Incident response resolved P1s within SLA in Q2.
CC7.2 requires continuous audit-log evidence retained for 12 months.
Flux usage costs rise about 1.5% a month; contractor rates rise about 1% a month.
Warehouse lineage is held by one role and is about 20% documented.
Refresh recovers from a failed batch via replay.
Invoicing consumes the reconciled ledger from billing-recon; billing runs on billing-platform.
The monthly close SOP defers warehouse lineage questions to the Data Platform Lead.
KYC screening reads the Identity verification dataset and the Corporate linkage dataset.
Apex Data auto-renews on day 60 with an 8% price uplift.
BeaconIQ term end, notice period and exit fee.
CinderSignals is the exclusive licensed source of intent signals.
DeltaVerify term end, notice period and exit fee.
EchoMarket renews on day 120 with a 12% price uplift; the termination section does not say whether EchoMarket history is retained after exit.
FluxBehavior is billed per record consumed.
GraniteGeo term end, notice period and exit fee.
The termination section does not say whether EchoMarket history is retained after exit.
Vendor-to-dataset feed matrix with attribute groups and consuming workflows.
Vendor reconciliation inputs include the internal audit-log dataset.
The Account intelligence dataset also feeds the Vendor reconciliation workflow each month.
